meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Hong Kong SAR (investor jurisdiction) / Mainland China (WFOE registration jurisdiction)

Arrangement between the Mainland of China and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region for the Avoidance of Double Taxation on Income (DTA)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Company Law of the PRC (revised 2023), Foreign Investment Law of the PRC (2020), Anti-Money Laundering Law of the PRC (as amended), PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3: Measures for the Administration of Filing Beneficial Owner Information by Enterprises (effective Nov 1, 2024); Hong Kong parent governed by Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (Cap. 615) and Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Change of Name Certificate (if any) of the Hong Kong parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by a Hong Kong Notary Public, then certification by China Legal Service (H.K.) Co., Ltd. for use in the Mainland; no Hague Apostille is applicable (Hong Kong is a SAR of China), and consular legalization is not used.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Registry Extract (e.g., Certificate of Incumbency) for the Hong Kong parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Hong Kong Companies Registry (or licensed company secretary for incumbency)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Same as certificate of incorporation: Hong Kong notarization plus China Legal Service (H.K.) Co., Ltd. certification; no Hague Apostille is applicable.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution or Power of Attorney authorizing the formation of the China WFOE and execution of incorporation documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the Hong Kong parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Signed board resolution must be notarized by a Hong Kong Notary Public and attested by China Legal Service (H.K.) Co., Ltd.; the PoA follows the same path and requires an apostille or consular legalization if the parent is outside Hong Kong (not applicable here).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (Constitutional Documents) of the Hong Kong parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Hong Kong Companies Registry / the Hong Kong parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified true copy by Hong Kong Notary Public and China Legal Service (H.K.) Co., Ltd. attestation; no apostille because Hong Kong is not a foreign state vis-à-vis the Mainland.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter from the Hong Kong parent's banker
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank in Hong Kong maintaining the parent's accounts
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank-issued letter with bank officer's certification; authenticated by Hong Kong notarization and China Legal Service (H.K.) Co., Ltd. seal; for any third-country bank documents, Hague Apostille applies if the bank's jurisdiction is an Apostille member, otherwise consular legalization.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All beneficial owners, directors, authorized signatories, and senior managers of the Hong Kong parent and the proposed WFOE must be screened against OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU Consolidated Sanctions List, the US consolidated sanctions list, and China's Ministry of Public Security and Ministry of State Security lists. Domestic and foreign politically exposed persons (PEPs), their immediate family members, and close associates require enhanced due diligence (EDD). For every beneficial owner at or above 25 percent, source of wealth and source of funds must be evidenced by bank statements, audited financial reports, and tax filings. Screening results, including nil results and hit cases, must be documented, escalated, and retained for at least five years for PBOC and SAMR inspection. Negative news screening, reliance on risk intelligence, and adverse-media checks are mandatory annually or upon trigger events.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Name and Registration Platform (Enterprise Name Self-Service Selection and Pre-registration System via www.samr.gov.cn)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The WFOE's Chinese name must use simplified Chinese characters and contain, in order: (1) an optional administrative division, (2) a distinctive name consisting of 2-10 characters, (3) an industry or operating character string describing the AI/video business, and (4) the legal form '有限责任公司'. Foreign investor names must be transliterated into Mandarin pinyin for documentation; an English name may be registered for banking and customs purposes but is not assessed by SAMR. The four-tier naming convention requires the first use of a unique distinctive token; identical or similar names in the same industry and administrative area are prohibited.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the SAMR rejects a name application, the submitting party may, within 60 days of the rejection decision, file a written administrative reconsideration application with the People's Government at the corresponding level (or the superior market regulation bureau). The application must set out the proposed name, the rejection grounds, relevant statutory provisions, and a persuasive argument distinguishing the name from prohibited or confusingly similar names. The reconsideration authority must decide within 60 days. If the reconsideration is unsuccessful, the applicant may bring an administrative lawsuit in the local Intermediate People's Court within 15 days after service of the reconsideration decision. Throughout, the applicant may simultaneously submit an alternative name reservation request to preserve priority. A successful appeal results in a fresh 30-day name reservation certificate.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is generally rejected by the State Taxation Administration and commercial banks for an AI/SaaS WFOE, because mandatory bookkeeping, invoicing, social insurance, and the money-laundering countermeasures require a physical operating address. The SAMR requires a legal address; a purely virtual address may lead to inclusion on the 'abnormally-operated enterprises' list and bank account freezing. Some Free Trade Zones allow registered address without physical office under 'same-region coordination' policies, but the site must host at least a staffed local compliance representative and accept statutory mail.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: 1) current lease agreement and landlord identification; 2) staff attendance logs; 3) actual office equipment and servers; 4) sales contracts and invoices; 5) social security contribution records; 6) business development samples. Municipal tax and market regulation authorities may conduct unannounced inspections for any enterprise, but high-risk AI-generated content activities raise the probability. Estimated likelihood: 20-30% during the first 12 months of operation (higher if applying for online content operating licenses or if the registered address is used by multiple companies).

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (Revised 2023, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 10, 23, 32, 37, 41, 46, 47, 48, 51, 59, 60, 83, 84, 88 and 95; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 2, 13, 28, 30, 31 and 34; Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Registration of Market Entities (State Council Decree No. 746), Articles 2, 8, 14, 15, 17, 20, 24, 25 and 27; Provisions on Foreign-Invested Enterprise Information Reporting (SAMR and MOFCOM, 2020), Articles 3, 5 and 8.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR); formation filing is accepted by the local Market Supervision Administration of the municipality or province where the WFOE's registered office is located, through the National Enterprise Registration Online Service Platform of China.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company (Market Entity Establishment Application) together with the approved Articles of Association and the Foreign Investment Information Report.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to an unrestricted software/AIGC services WFOE. The registered capital amount may be set by the shareholders in the Articles of Association. Under the PRC Company Law (2023), Article 47, all subscribed capital must be fully paid up within five years from establishment unless a shorter period is required by law or regulation. No escrow or blocked capital account is required for this business scope; the contribution schedule must simply be recorded in the Articles of Association and the Foreign Investment Information Report.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF CN WFOE LTD. (the 'Company'). Acting by unanimous written consent of the sole shareholder and the initial board members of the Company in accordance with the PRC Company Law and the Articles of Association of the Company, the following resolutions are hereby adopted with immediate effect. 1. Share Capital and Subscription. RESOLVED, that the subscription of the registered capital of the Company, as set out in the approved Articles of Association, is hereby ratified, confirmed, and accepted, and that each shareholder shall pay its subscribed capital in cash or permitted in-kind contribution in accordance with the published contribution schedule, with all outstanding contributions to be fully paid not later than five years from the date of registration or such earlier date as may be required by applicable law, regulation, or banking KYC requirements. 2. Registered Office. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company shall be [REGISTERED OFFICE ADDRESS] (the 'Registered Office'), that such office is hereby formally adopted as the statutory seat, registered address, and address for service of process of the Company, and that the legal representative is authorised to execute, deliver, and perform all tenancy, service, and property agreements in respect of the Registered Office. 3. Banking Mandate. RESOLVED, that the Company shall establish its primary corporate banking relationship at [BANK NAME] (the 'Bank'), that the Bank is hereby authorised to open and maintain all firm accounts, current accounts, foreign currency accounts, and any digital SaaS payment collection accounts, and that the legal representative and the finance manager shall be authorised signatories, with any two authorised signatories jointly required for all disbursements above USD 10,000 and any single authorised signatory for internal transfers below such threshold. 4. Statutory Officers. RESOLVED, that [LEGAL REPRESENTATIVE NAME] is appointed as executive director and legal representative, [GENERAL MANAGER NAME] is appointed as general manager, and [SUPERVISOR NAME] is appointed as supervisor, each to hold office until removal by the shareholder in accordance with the Articles of Association. 5. Filing and Execution. RESOLVED, that the executive director and legal representative are jointly and severally authorised to sign, submit, receipt, and make corrections to incorporation applications, tax registrations, social insurance registrations, company seal applications, bank account applications, anti-money-laundering questionnaires, and any other forms or notifications required by the State Administration for Market Regulation or other competent authorities. RESOLVED FURTHER, that each resolution shall be binding upon the Company and all officers, may be executed in counterparts, and shall be inserted into the corporate records duly kept by the general manager. This written resolution is effective immediately upon execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-registration name availability check and foreign investment scope screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Registration Online Service; local Market Supervision Administration at the intended registered city
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the SAMR enterprise registration portal and submit a proposed Chinese and English company name with a preliminary business scope matching AI software development, AIGC avatar video generation, and SaaS distribution. Confirm that the proposed business is not within the Foreign Investment Negative List; for unrestricted activities no special approval is required. Obtain or generate an electronic name-notice and freeze the name. Complete a negative-list self-declaration and record the intended jurisdiction where the legal address will be registered. If a locally administered unrestricted industry requires additional licensing, attach the negative-list result to the formation dossier for the later establishment application.
required_dossiers: Passport or corporate identity of each shareholder
Certificate of incorporation and business registration of the Hong Kong investing entity
Proposed Chinese and English company names
Preliminary business scope text based on ISIC 6201/NAICS 511210
Written authorization to a local registration agent (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name application is rejected on grounds of duplication, illegality, or prohibited characters, promptly file an amended name application with at least three alternative names; the online system normally permits re-submission within one business day without requiring a fresh filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization, legalization and attestation of foreign investor corporate documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: China-appointed Notary Public in Hong Kong and China Legal Service (Hong Kong) Limited; PRC Embassy or Consulate for legalization only if required by the local SAMR
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain certified copies of the Hong Kong investor's Certificate of Incorporation, Business Registration Certificate, Register of Directors and Shareholders, and board resolution authorizing formation of the mainland WFOE. The Hong Kong investor must arrange notarization by a China-appointed Notary Public; thereafter the notarial certificate should be transmitted to China Legal Service (Hong Kong) Limited for sealing and forwarding to the mainland registry. Ensure certified translations into English if requested, and prepare two original sets for the local SAMR and tax authority. Retain one complete scanned set in the corporate record book for subsequent bank KYC production.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation of the Hong Kong investor
Hong Kong Business Registration Certificate
Certificate of good standing or incumbency of the Hong Kong investor
Register of directors and shareholders of the Hong Kong investor
Board resolution of the Hong Kong investor approving WFOE formation and capital contribution
Notarial certificate issued by a China-appointed Notary Public in Hong Kong
Legal representative ID and director ID copies of the Hong Kong investor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the local SAMR rejects the notarial certificate for defective notarial wording, the Hong Kong investor's counsel shall prepare an amended notarial certificate; no substantive filing is lost and the same application may be resubmitted with the corrected certificate within the pending application period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of establishment registration application and Articles of Association to Market Supervision Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration of the registered office city; National Enterprise Registration Online Service Platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the Market Entity Establishment Application, execute the Articles of Association by all subscribers, appoint the legal representative, executive director, supervisor and general manager, and upload all notarized investor documents to the online registration system. If the local MSA requires hard copies, submit stamped paper originals in person or via a licensed agency. Pay zero official filing fee; the system will generate a reception notice. The application will be evaluated against the negative list, name notice, capital schedule, and office proof before issuance of the business license with a unique social credit code.
required_dossiers: Completed establishment application form on the SAMR template
Notarized Articles of Association signed by all shareholders
Name pre-approval notice
Notarized identity and incumbency documents of the Hong Kong investor
ID copies of the appointed legal representative, executive director, supervisor and general manager
Proof of registered office (lease certificate or property ownership certificate) and landlord building use letter
Foreign Investment Information Report (electronic filing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or suspended, SAMR issues one written notice listing all deficiencies; the applicant must cure deficiencies within the statutory time limit, generally 15 working days from the notice. Re-upload corrected documents and request resumption of the original application number; if the deadline is missed, re-apply without an additional official filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business license collection, seal carving and consolidated tax registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration for license issuance; Public Security Bureau-approved seal engraving service; State Taxation Administration local tax service via the Electronic Tax Bureau
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After approval, collect the original business license and unique social credit code certificate. Take the license, legal representative ID card, and written authorization to a Public Security Bureau-approved engraving unit to cut the company seal, finance seal, invoice seal, contract seal, and legal representative name seal. The market administration shares registration information with the tax authority under the one-stop integration mechanism; verify tax registration by logging onto the Electronic Tax Bureau, complete demographic information, choose tax status including general versus small-scale VAT payer classification, and activate the digital tax control device.
required_dossiers: Original business license
Approval notice of establishment
Legal representative ID card
Seal carving application form
Notarized Articles of Association
Office address proof and lease agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If seal carving is incomplete, return to the MSA and obtain a corrected registration notice; if tax activation fails because of mismatched legal representative or address data, apply for data correction through the online one-account tax service before any tax filing is due.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate settlement bank account opening and payment-rail KYC enablement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank selected by the first board resolution; People's Bank of China as regulator of settlement accounts
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the business license, company seal set, first board resolution, authorization letters, and beneficial ownership forms to the chosen bank's corporate account department. Complete anti-money-laundering due diligence, KYC forms, and actual controller declaration. Open the RMB basic settlement account and, if needed, a foreign currency account. Configure online banking entitlements and a payment approval matrix per the first board resolution. If the SaaS platform collects through Stripe or Paddle and receives inbound cross-border payouts, the legal representative shall make the necessary declarations to the bank and to the State Administration of Foreign Exchange data system when receiving cross-border receivables.
required_dossiers: Original business license
Company seal, financial seal and legal representative seal
First board resolution appointing bank signatories
Legal representative and finance manager ID cards
Beneficial ownership and AML KYC forms
Office lease and proof of operating address
Bank account application forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank freezes or queries the account application for incomplete KYC, supply additional source-of-funds declarations and notarized investor background documents and re-file within 10 working days. If the bank declines because it misclassifies AIGC software as high-risk, present the business license and a written explanation that the activity is software services, not financial services.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable - the Company is a pure digital software and AI avatar video generation service provider under ISIC 6201/NAICS 511210; no manufacturing, chemical, assembly, or warehousing facilities will be operated.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - no industrial production license, manufacturing permit, or Civil Defense fire permit is required for the registered software and SaaS scope.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not Applicable - no construction, factory, or physical production project is being registered with an environmental protection agency.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not Applicable - exempt from Environmental Impact Assessment classification because the WFOE will not construct fixed production facilities; office-only activities are categorically not listed in the EIA catalogue.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable - zero wastewater discharge, zero VOC emission, and zero hazardous waste generation; only ordinary office waste is produced and must be segregated in accordance with local municipal waste management rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable - no Civil Defense fire acceptance certificate or structural load inspection is mandated for an office-bound software company. The Company must still comply with the PRC Fire Protection Law by maintaining a valid fire egress plan, standard portable fire extinguishers, and a leasehold office that has passed municipal fire-safety inspection; no industrial occupational clearance is required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA), with the national website portal www.chinatax.gov.cn and the provincial STA Electronic Tax Office e-filing/registration platforms; customs-related export clearance is administered by the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China through the China International Trade Single Window.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For the PRC Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE), the statutory Tax Identification Number is the 18-character Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) printed on the business license. After market-administration company formation, the WFOE must complete tax registration within 30 calendar days. The WFOE logs into the provincial STA Electronic Tax Office or visits the competent local STA service hall, then submits the business license, articles of association, legal representative identity certificate, registered address proof, bank account information, and shareholder/capital information. The tax authority assigns the taxpayer registration file, tax jurisdiction, VAT taxpayer type, and tax categories. Because China uses multi-license integration, no separate paper VAT registration certificate is issued; the USCC is the VAT and corporate income tax ID for the WFOE. For a foreign non-resident enterprise without a permanent establishment but with PRC-source income, the non-resident enterprise must complete non-resident tax record-filing via the Electronic Tax Office through the payer/withholding agent, submit a home-jurisdiction tax residence certificate and relevant contracts, and obtain a non-resident tax identification record for withholding-tax administration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. PRC law does not provide a US-style check-the-box election or hybrid-mismatch election; the WFOE is mandatorily an entity-level taxpayer. For VAT collection purposes only, taxpayers with annual taxable sales at or below RMB 5,000,000 may elect to be small-scale VAT taxpayers, and enterprises above the threshold must be general VAT taxpayers; this is not an entity classification election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: An enterprise with annual taxable sales exceeding RMB 5,000,000 excluding VAT is obliged to register as a general VAT taxpayer; enterprises at or below that threshold may remain small-scale VAT taxpayers. A non-resident enterprise engaged in taxable sales in the PRC must either VAT register or have VAT withheld by the domestic purchaser.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All VAT invoices are issued through the STA tax-control invoice system (Golden Tax system). Special VAT invoices and fully digitalized electronic invoices must be transmitted in real time to the STA's national electronic invoice platform, carry the tax authority's digital signature and anti-fraud encryption, and be cleared against the taxpayer's VAT return. Qualified taxpayers may integrate ERP systems with the STA e-invoice application programming interface API for real-time issuance and reporting; unauthorized offline invoice printing, false invoice issuance, or non-reconciliation with the tax return triggers automatic tax-control alerts and penalty actions.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Tangible goods exported from the PRC customs territory are zero-rated for VAT if they are physically exported under a valid Customs export declaration and all export sales proceeds are repatriated through licensed PRC banks and reported to the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE). Cross-border sales of qualifying digital software services, including AI avatar video generation platform services supplied to an overseas customer where the service is wholly performed and consumed outside the PRC, may be zero-rated or exempt if the WFOE is a general VAT taxpayer, the contract is with an offshore party, the service has no PRC domestic beneficiary, and the foreign currency consideration is repatriated to a PRC bank account within the prescribed FX period.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Goods Declaration (the electronically transmitted and Customs-released export declaration)
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or equivalent transport document evidencing physical export
Foreign Exchange Receipt Voucher / bank export-proceeds collection record domiciled through SAFE
Export sales contract or purchase order
Export VAT rebate filing documentation and underlying input-VAT special invoices of the exporting entity
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export VAT zero-rating and refund claims are jointly scrutinised by STA, Customs, and SAFE. Missing, false, or mismatched customs declarations; non-arrival of goods; unrepatriated or circular FX receipts; sham offshore service arrangements; or forged bills of lading will result in denial of the claimed zero rate, full recovery of refunded VAT, daily overdue interest at 0.05%, late-payment surcharges, and administrative fines of 50%-500% of the tax evaded under the Tax Collection and Administration Law. Fraudulent conduct may be prosecuted as false invoice issuance or export tax refund fraud, with criminal liability including imprisonment and confiscation of property, and the entity may be downgraded in Customs credit classification, lose export rebate facilitation, and be placed on tax risk control watch-lists.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) acting under the mandate of the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a distinctly bifurcated foreign exchange regime. The current account, covering trade in goods, services, and conventional profit remittances associated with verified business operations, is substantially convertible after genuine transaction verification. Banks under SAFE supervision exercise post-hoc auditing and require underlying contracts, invoices, customs declarations, tax certificates, and board resolutions. The capital account remains closely controlled. A WFOE established as a foreign direct investment vehicle receives inbound equity capital through a designated FDI capital settlement account, with the proceeds tracked under SAFE's Foreign Exchange Integrated Management Platform. RMB conversion for capital items is restricted and must be aligned with a declared negative-list business purpose. Profit repatriation to the Hong Kong parent is permitted only after annual audit, corporate income tax settlement, and satisfaction of the remittance bank's evidence requirements; a 10% withholding tax may apply unless a tax treaty claim under Mainland-HK arrangements reduces the rate. Currency convertibility for a software licensing and AI video generation business is therefore workable for current operational liquidity but requires disciplined documentary discipline for dividends, IP royalty outflows, and overseas SaaS subscription receipts. The WFOE cannot freely swap RMB for foreign currency without an underlying real transaction; capital flight transactions, round-tripping schemes, and fabricated service agreements are actively scrutinized. The practical effect is that a China WFOE needs to maintain a domestic RMB and dual-currency treasury stack, appoint a relationship manager with cross-border expertise, and pre-clear each material outward remittance with the branch compliance team to avoid frozen transfers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export foreign currency proceeds must be repatriated to a domestic foreign exchange account in China within 180 days from the date of expected collection, subject to the contractually agreed settlement period. The mandatory conversion ratio is zero percent: since 2012 China abolished forced surrender, so the WFOE may freely retain export receipts in foreign currency or voluntarily settle them into RMB at commercial bank rates. SAFE requires the underlying customs declaration, commercial invoices, shipping/airway bills, and service delivery evidence for AI software exports to be archived for verification. Failure to repatriate within the statutory window or falsification of export documentation triggers SAFE penalties, blacklist revision, and forced suspension of the entity's cross-border collection rights.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Capital Settlement Account and Basic Operational RMB Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Capital Settlement Account and General Foreign Currency Account
Basic Deposit Account for RMB Treasury Operations
Settlement Account for Export Receipts and Trade-Related Payments

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore fintech EMIs and cross-border digital banking providers are not directly viable for the China WFOE as stand-alone bank accounts. PBOC and SAFE prohibit unlicensed foreign payment institutions from servicing onshore Chinese legal entities without an onshore payment business license and a clearing bank partner. Global platforms such as Stripe, Paddle, and Airwallex cannot open deposit accounts or conduct foreign exchange settlements inside China for the WFOE directly. They can be used only as foreign collection gateways for overseas B2B and B2C customers, with net funds periodically swept through a licensed domestic receiving bank via SWIFT MT103 or through a licensed cross-border payment institution under SAFE's cross-border payment regulatory pilot. The WFOE should treat such fintech rails as low-value collection conduits, not as treasury counterparties, and should maintain every customer subscription invoice and platform payout report for local bank KYC reviews. Any claim that a foreign EMI can replace a Chinese-tier-one bank account is a material compliance failure.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For the WFOE's inaugural account opening, the statutory legal representative and at least one authorized director must physically attend the bank branch in China, hold the company chop and original corporate documents, and complete a face-to-face compliance interview. Remote consular proxy opening is not permitted for a newly formed PRC subsidiary. After the initial in-branch interview, some PBOC-licensed banks allow video interview enhancement for additional FX or capital accounts; however SAFE's verification of the FDI capital account generally requires the legal representative's physical presence at least once. Foreign resident directors unable to travel must execute a notarized power of attorney delegating onshore board authority to a Chinese-resident designated officer, but the legal representative remains ultimately responsible for AML compliance and statutory filings.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity caused by the Hong Kong intermediate holding company threshold, with the Chinese bank unable to observe the natural persons ultimately controlling the AI software enterprise from the filing documents alone.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a notarized and apostilled Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Incumbency, register of directors, register of shareholders, and a consolidated beneficial ownership disclosure showing every individual with a direct or indirect ownership interest above 10%. The chart must be reconciled with the Hong Kong parent's operating bank references, statutory filing records, and a signed declaration of source of wealth for each ultimate shareholder, supported by audited financial statements where available.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border intellectual property monetization red flag: the China WFOE receives proprietary AI video generation technology or licenses from the Hong Kong parent, and the bank cannot determine whether IP payments are genuinely priced or a disguised dividend repatriation channel.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver a complete IP licensing agreement with royalty formula benchmarks, SAFE and tax bureau registration receipts for outbound royalty filing, an independent intellectual property valuation report, technical service agreements describing actual development responsibilities, payroll records of WFOE R&D engineers, and a transfer pricing disclosure aligning net margins with the OECD ALP. The documentation must prove the WFOE is not merely a cost-plus shell.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency, low-value SaaS subscription receipts from a global customer base create a penetration risk that the account will be used to layer funds generated from undisclosed end customers, particularly if the platform's merchant IDs or payment processor records are inaccessible.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a comprehensive know-your-customer policy, sanctions screening software description, transaction monitoring system logs, a representative list of enterprise clients accounting for the majority of ARR, signed SaaS license agreements with payment terms, and three months of processor payout reports from the payment gateways. For any individual subscription above USD 10,000, the bank will expect beneficial owner identification evidence collected at the point of sale.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistency between reported business scope and actual cross-border money movement: an AI avatar video generation company simultaneously declaring software royalties, cloud infrastructure payments, advertising expense, and employee equity incentive remittances may trigger a structured-activity alert.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Prepare a treasury cash-flow projection with vendor invoices for cloud GPUs, colocation fees, software tool licenses, international intellectual property renewals, and equitable share-based payment plans. Add an external audit opinion for the most recent two fiscal years, a Chinese CPA capital verification report, and a notarized board resolution enumerating each outbound remittance purpose. The bank compliance committee will cross-map every line item to the WFOE's actual preferred-capex and OPEX cycle.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The Hong Kong shareholder must initiate a SWIFT MT103 transfer from its corporate account to the WFOE's designated FDI capital settlement account at a tier-one Chinese bank. The remittance instruction must clearly state the FX purpose code for direct investment capital injection and reference the SAFE Foreign Investment Enterprise registration file. The domestic bank will verify the capital injection against the registered foreign exchange information, the shareholder resolution, and the articles of association. Post-receipt, the WFOE must obtain a certified public accountant capital verification report and file it with the local market supervision authority. RMB settlement of the foreign exchange capital is permitted only for legal business purposes included in the negative-list screening; the bank will request supporting contracts and invoices before converting the credits. The WFOE should never commingle shareholder loans, trade receivables, and equity capital in the same settlement order or the transfer will be rejected on SAFE regulatory checks.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For recurring AI video generation SaaS license fees and software subscription settlements, use SWIFT MT103 wire transfers with the applicable SAFE service trade declaration code, a fully itemized commercial invoice, the underlying license agreement, and tax clearance proof. For physical hardware procurement or encoding equipment purchases, the preferred rails are SWIFT MT103 for payments under 30 days and Commercial Letters of Credit (MT700) for higher-value imports to protect royalty and delivery conditions. Documentary collections are acceptable only for low-risk repetitive software distribution payments from counterparties with established payment discipline, but they are not recommended for cloud infrastructure payments due to timing inefficiency. Every USD 50,000 or equivalent outbound service payment will require the bank's current-account verification, and any payment to a sanctions-restricted jurisdiction will require an automatic hold and PEP screening. The WFOE must maintain a traceable repository of customer support records, license usage logs, and platform revenue reports to substantiate that outbound disbursements align with genuine commercial operations.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore forward foreign exchange contracts (forward settlement and sale) with a licensed PBOC/SAFE-designated bank for genuine current account trade receipts and payments
Currency options with real trade or investment background for CFO-level rental of USD/RMB volatility
Cross-currency swaps executed between the WFOE and an onshore bank to hedge long-term FDI capital repayment exposures, subject to SAFE registration for capital account hedging
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) through the Hong Kong parent treasury, not through the China WFOE account, because onshore NDF use by a PRC domestic entity is not generally permitted

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 42 days after the anniversary of incorporation date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If delivered after 42 days: HKD 1,200 (3 months or less), HKD 2,400 (more than 3 but not more than 6 months), HKD 3,600 (more than 6 but not more than 9 months), HKD 4,800 (more than 9 months). Repeated default can lead to prosecution and administrative strike-off of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally issued on the first working day of April (for December year-end) or based on accounting year-end; filing deadline is 1 month from the date of issue (extensions available for tax representatives)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties: HKD 1,200 for first offence, HKD 3,000 for second offence; further fines and imprisonment for persistent non-compliance, plus estimated assessments.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Hong Kong Business Registration Office (Inland Revenue Department)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month before the expiry date of the current business registration certificate (annually or triennially)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal penalty of HKD 300 per certificate; continued non-renewal may result in prosecution and a fine of HKD 5,000 and six months' imprisonment. The business may also be deprived of valid proof of registration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Every Hong Kong incorporated company must undergo an independent statutory audit under Section 141 of the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) unless it is a private company with revenue not exceeding HKD 10 million, total assets not exceeding HKD 10 million, and fewer than 100 employees, AND all its shareholders have passed a unanimous resolution to dispense with the audit. Dormant companies also qualify for exemption. Any company exceeding any of these quantitative thresholds, or failing to obtain unanimous shareholder consent, is legally required to appoint a certified public accountant registered under the Professional Accountants Ordinance to audit its financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Hong Kong Financial Reporting Standards (HKFRS) which converge fully with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). Qualified smaller entities may adopt HKFRS for Private Entities (SME Standard) if they are not required to file with a statutory regulator and meet the eligibility criteria.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Hong Kong does not require an annual UBO filing to the government. Instead, every company must maintain a Significant Controllers Register (SCR) at its registered office (or other prescribed location). The register must include details of each significant controller (any individual with 25% or more of the voting rights, capital, or significant influence). Any change to the register must be recorded within 15 days after the company learns of the change. The register is available for inspection by law enforcement officers, but no annual confirmation is required to be submitted to the Companies Registry.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Preferential 15% for High and New Technology Enterprises, 5% effective for Small Low-Profit Enterprises, 100% super deduction for qualified R&D expenses, 15% for encouraged industries in pilot free trade zones, and tax holidays for key integrated circuit industries.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: A100000 Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Form A) and supplementary schedules; electronic filing through the Integrated Electronic Tax Office (China Tax eTax) portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final settlement with quarterly (or monthly) provisional prepayments.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return must be filed and settled within 5 months after the end of the tax year (on or before May 31 of the following year). Quarterly prepayments are due within 15 days after the end of each quarter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Sales revenue / operating income, covering all income from provision of software-as-a-service, AI avatar video generation subscriptions, license fees, and customization services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include worldwide revenue of the Chinese resident WFOE. Recalculate any revenue received from the Hong Kong parent or other related parties using the arm's length principle; disclose related-party invoices and contracts in the attached transfer pricing filing. Avoid classifying software license fees as royalties to the HK parent without valid economic substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating costs: direct expenses for AI model development, cloud infrastructure, video render, personnel costs, and outsourced service fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the WFOE pays fees to the HK parent for software development or technical support, such payments must be deducted in accordance with the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines. Keep contemporaneous accounting data and disclose in Schedule A105000 if the cost is more than the allowed cap.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Business taxes and surcharges (VAT, urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges, etc.).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: VAT zero-rating or tax exemption should be applied for exported research and development services; nevertheless, the CIT return remains based on revenue net of VAT. The amount of VAT not creditable is deductible as part of the costs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling expenses including platform fees charged by Stripe/Paddle and overseas marketing costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Commissions paid to overseas sales agents may be subject to Chinese withholding tax if they are considered sourced in China under the permanent establishment rule. Verify whether the agent carries on business in China and whether a 10% WHT under Article 37 applies to fees paid to non-residents.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: General and administrative expenses: management fees, staff salaries, rent, professional fees, and corporate overhead.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Management fees paid to the HK parent for supervisory or administrative services are not deductible unless supported by verified service contracts, cost documentation, and evidence that the services are rendered and not duplicative. Strictly apply the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines to the mark-up on services.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Financial expenses: interest on borrowing and bank charges, net of foreign exchange gains.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest paid to the HK parent or related lender must be at arm's length. Deductions are limited by the thin capitalization ratio of 2:1 for non-financial enterprises. Withholding tax at 10% (or 7% under the Mainland-Hong Kong DTA for a bank/financial institution) must be withheld and declared on the interest payment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total profit calculated as Box 1 through Box 6 adjusted by operating result.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This is the accounting profit reported under Chinese GAAP. Cross-border adjustments, such as unrealised intercompany profits, must be reversed to reflect the arm's length position.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income adjustments—increase: nondeductible expenses, excessive entertainment expenses, internal service charges, and impairment provisions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Adjust for intercompany charges that have been rejected under transfer pricing examinations. Amounts paid to the HK parent that do not meet the beneficial incidence test are added back to taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income adjustments—decrease: tax-exempt dividend income from Chinese resident enterprises and qualified technology transfer gains.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the HK parent redirects dividends from Chinese subsidiaries, the WFOE may not deduct such distribution as an expense. For foreign tax credits, apply to taxes paid abroad on foreign-sourced income.
A loss may be carried forward for five years, or longer for qualified high-tech companies. The taxable income must be allocated accurately for any non-resident deemed profit taxation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable corporate income tax rate: 25%, or preferential rates if qualified.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The effective rate of 15% for High and New Technology Enterprise status may be used if the WFOE holds a valid HNTE certificate. For a non-resident with a permanent establishment, that establishment uses the same rate schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income tax payable before credits: tax base × rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Adjust for foreign tax credits claimed for taxes paid abroad on Chinese source income. The total tax credit shall not exceed the Chinese tax payable on that foreign-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits and exemptions: qualified foreign tax credit, dividend withholding tax credits, and deferred tax for reinvestment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the WFOE is a distributing enterprise, profit repatriation to Hong Kong triggers WHT; this withholding is not a tax credit in the CIT return but is handled in the withholding tax declaration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable (refundable) after deducting quarterly prepayments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The final payment must match the amount of quarterly provisional payments. In case of refund, the refund will be processed after mandatory tax audit; in case of overdue balance, daily late surcharge at 0.05% applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Related-party transaction reporting (Form F200000 and schedules).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory when the WFOE performs transactions with the HK parent or any related party. Schedule F ensures that royalties, interests, and service pricing are fully disclosed. Failure to disclose triggers special tax adjustment and penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file by May 31 will trigger a fine of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 under Article 62 of the Tax Administration Law; late payment creates a daily surcharge of 0.05% from the original due date; inaccurate filing causing underpayment incurs an administrative penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax; serious evasion with an unpaid amount exceeding RMB 50,000 and accounting for more than 10% of the total tax payable may lead to criminal proceedings under Article 201 of the Criminal Law, with imprisonment up to seven years and substantial fines.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% under Article 37 of the Corporate Income Tax Law; reduced to 5% under the Mainland–Hong Kong DTA upon meeting the 25% shareholding and beneficial ownership conditions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim treaty relief, the distributing WFOE must withhold at the reduced rate only after receiving the following: (1) a valid Hong Kong Tax Residency Certificate issued by the Inland Revenue Department; (2) a completed Beneficial Ownership Declaration confirming the HK company is the true owner of the dividend and does not withhold any part for a third party; (3) an economic substance self-assessment including HK board minutes, office lease, employees, and bank records; (4) an application/information form as required under the FDI tax treaty claim process, file these via the eTax portal before making the distribution; the competent authority may reject the claim if the HK parent is determined to be a conduit, in which case the 10% statutory rate applies along with late interest and penalties.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory: interest 10%, royalties 10%. Under the Mainland–Hong Kong DTA (Art. 11/12): interest 7% (for banks or financial institutions carrying on business in HK; otherwise 10%); royalties 7%. Procedural requirements: the WFOE must obtain the HK Tax Residency Certificate and maintain a record proving the beneficial ownership and that the royalties are for the use of IP in China, with a valid license contract registered with the tax authority.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File mandatory if any of the following related-party transaction thresholds are met in a tax year: RMB 200 million for tangible assets, RMB 100 million for intangible assets, RMB 100 million for financial assets, and RMB 40 million for services. Master File mandatory if aggregate related-party transactions exceed RMB 1 billion; a Country-by-Country Report is required when the MNE group's consolidated revenue exceeds RMB 5.5 billion.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China applies the OECD substance-over-form and Principal Purpose Test in relation to the DTA. The WFOE must carry on legitimate business operations in China, and the Hong Kong shareholder must have real economic substance in Hong Kong to qualify for treaty benefits. Both China's special tax adjustment rules and Hong Kong's FSIE economic substance rules require that risks, functions, and assets match the income. A WFOE with CIGA in China and supporting employees, software server infrastructure, and board oversight is necessary to avoid an attribution challenge; the lack of substance leads to denial of treaty benefits or PE exposure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately failing to record subscription revenue from AI avatar video SaaS customers paid through Stripe/Paddle into overseas merchant accounts, or manipulating the taxable income through fictitious intercompany payments to the Hong Kong parent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 63 of the Tax Administration Law imposes a penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax; Article 201 of the Criminal Law imposes imprisonment up to 7 years and fines for tax evasion exceeding the criminal threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who order or knowingly permit false declarations are personally liable under the Company Law for the corporate tax debt and may have personal assets subject to restitution. The competent tax authority can restrict legal representatives from leaving China under the exit-clearance rules, and criminal liability (detention or imprisonment) may attach to the directly responsible director.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using a virtually non-substantive Hong Kong subsidiary as the shareholder of the WFOE to access the 5% preferential dividend withholding tax rate, while all decisions, management, and economic activities remain in mainland China or with the ultimate beneficial owner in a third jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Chinese tax authority will deny the 5% DTA relief under the Beneficial Ownership rule and the Principal Purpose Test (Article 7 of BEPS MLI), back-charge the 10% withholding tax difference, and apply default interest and late-filling penalties. Under the Tax Administration Law Article 94, treaty abuse constitutes a ground for special tax adjustment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The directors of the WFOE who approve dividend distributions without verifying the HK shareholder's substance can be held personally responsible for the under-withheld tax, with restitution of the corporate assets; civil travel bans, asset freezes, and a director disqualification order may be issued. If the structure is construed as criminal tax evasion, the directors face imprisonment up to 7 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE fails to disclose the ultimate beneficial owner behind the Hong Kong parent and omits the required reportable cross-border fund transfer connected to royalty payments to a Low-risk (per AML-tagging) but artificially tax-haven-linked shell entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 50 of the PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law imposes fines up to RMB 5 million on the entity, suspension or shutdown of operations; Article 191 of the Criminal Law punishes money-laundering with imprisonment from 5 to 10 years and fines for severe violations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative and responsible senior managers are subject to individual fines up to RMB 500,000, cannot depart the jurisdiction without tax clearance, and may be criminally prosecuted for money laundering, with civil asset seizure and a ban against acting as company directors for up to 10 years.
